newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ASM LITHO DOWN AFTER 1996 RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: ASM LITHO DOWN AFTER 1996 RESULTS.

text.p: Shares in Dutch semiconductor equipment maker ASM Lithography slipped 7.30 guilders or 6.5 percent to 103.70 guilders on Thursday after unveiling 1996 net profits of 218 million guilders against 131 million in 1995.

Dealers said the results were in line with expectations and reasonably well received but they noted that Philips Electronics, which has a 35 percent stake in the company, announced it would sell 3.95 million ordinary ASM Litho shares by a public offering. This would cut Philip's stake in ASM Lithography to 23.9 percent from 35.4 percent.
